name: review change
description: Judge code reviews: that a dangerous change is blocked, a harmless one approved, and that findings name the real problem.

input.title: Look up orders by customer name
input.description: Adds a search endpoint for support staff.
input.diff:
--- a/app/orders.py
+++ b/app/orders.py
@@ -40,3 +40,8 @@
+def find_orders(connection, customer_name):
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer = '{customer_name}'"
+    return connection.execute(query).fetchall()

expected.description: The SQL injection blocks the change, raised by the security reviewer at high severity.

input.title: Rename total to order_total
input.description: A clearer name; no behavior changes.
input.diff:
--- a/app/totals.py
+++ b/app/totals.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
-def total(order):
+def order_total(order):
     return sum(line.price * line.quantity for line in order.lines)

expected.description: A pure rename is approved with no findings.

input.title: Look up orders by customer name
input.description: Adds a search endpoint for support staff.
input.diff:
--- a/app/orders.py
+++ b/app/orders.py
@@ -40,3 +40,8 @@
+def find_orders(connection, customer_name):
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer = '{customer_name}'"
+    return connection.execute(query).fetchall()

expected.description: A review that blocks the change because the customer name is interpolated into the SQL query, allowing SQL injection, and suggests a parameterized query.

findings.summary: customer_name is interpolated into the SQL query, allowing SQL injection.
findings.suggestion: Pass customer_name as a query parameter.

input.title: Paginate the order list
input.diff:
--- a/app/pages.py
+++ b/app/pages.py
@@ -1,0 +1,4 @@
+def page_of(items, page, size):
+    start = page * size
+    return items[start:start + size]

expected.description: A review that flags the off-by-one error: with pages counted from 1, page 1 skips the first page of items, so start should be (page - 1) * size.

findings.summary: Pages count from 1, so page * size skips the first page.
